purpose: Persist the assistant's visual screening of the 180-image creative explicit preview set. This is not a detector result and not a human-authoritative label set. Human review remains required before any training-approved or production use.
notes: Flickr discovery buckets were heavily polluted by keyword collisions, non-human images, renders and irrelevant photos, especially explicit_act and full_frontal_genitalia.

A cropped, faceless or anonymous adult/sexual subject is not discarded merely because age cannot be visually proven. Such images are important research examples because Artes will receive similar uploads.

Public Flickr provenance is sufficient to keep a candidate in local web research when there is no concrete minor-safety concern, but Flickr publication is not stored as proof that a depicted subject is 18+.
Only affirmative minor-safety concern is separated for human safety review; inability to verify age alone is not treated as affirmative concern.
Second-pass inspection corrected several contact-sheet overcalls: cropped/topless images without visible nipple were not counted as female_bare_breasts.
Discovery tags are not detector labels and are not used as label authority.
